overview: In the 1930's, two influential families – the Dexters and the Soongs – are thrown into chaos when John Dexter and Julie Soong fall in love. Can their relationship endure throughout the fall of Singapore and the ravages of the Second World War?
title: Tanamera – Lion of Singapore

overview: For years the Raney family has helped novice homesteaders around the country save their homesteads from brink of failure and helped to bring their dreams of living off the grid to life. Now, inspired by years' worth of rescues, Marty Raney will attempt his greatest recue of all – his very own 40-acre homestead. In an all new series, Homestead Rescue: Raney Ranch, the Raneys take on the most ambitious project the family has ever attempted, to build a multi-generational homestead.
title: Homestead Rescue: Raney Ranch

overview: Feeling vexed? In a tizz? Whatever your bother Keith is here to ‘elp, and every week you'll see him demolish a variety of your problems with the help of a different celebrity helper. From helping the nation with their niggles, to making their dreams come true, everything Keith does will include a big twist of Lemon!
title: Keith Lemon's LemonAid

overview: The last years in the life of Robert Louis Stevenson, when he left Great Britain for Sydney and west Samoa.
title: Tusitala

overview: Unnatural Causes is a British television anthology series comprising seven stand-alone episodes, the series explored deaths in unusual circumstances. The series writers included Beryl Bainbridge, Nigel Kneale and Lynda La Plante.
title: Unnatural Causes

overview: Intruder follows affluent, high-flying married couple Rebecca and Sam, whose idyllic lives are shattered after two local teenagers break into their coastal home.
title: Intruder

overview: In the 20th anniversary year of the hit show, Location, Location, Location: 20 Years and Counting will bring together some of our most memorable stories from the past offering up the social history, from bust to boom and back, of house buying in Britain over a generation. Each episode will explore a theme, from the toughest markets over the years and the times people have questioned whether it's a good time to buy a property, to million-pound homes and first-time buying. Punctuating some of our top home search stories, there will be new stats, giving rundowns on how buying property has changed over the years. Crucially though, each programme will be naturally filled with the energy and tone we've come to know and love from the series. Lots of lovely properties, lots of tricky searches and lots of fun from Kirstie and Phil.
title: Location, Location, Location: 20 Years and Counting

overview: The Cleaners tells how, in the near future, inanimate objects carry the memories of people's experiences, and a certain number of the population have the ability to relive those memories by touch. Cleaners are specialists hired to sanitize the objects and relieve emotional burdens these memories may hold. At the center of this story is a young man who inherits his family's cleaning business, and takes on a mysterious new commission.
title: The Cleaners

overview: Inspired by true events, Call It What You Want follows a BL director James, who starts a secret relationship with Ait, the lead actor in his new series. Ait's co-star, Bas, is feeling the pressure of the BL industry: plastic surgery, strict diets and, worst of all, he is suffering the harassment of the producer of the series. At the same time, Marco, James' Taiwanese friend, is heartbroken when he finds out about the relationship between his friend and Ait. But when he learns about Bas situation, the two of them will embark on a healing trip together.
title: Call It What You Want

overview: The series feature like a new kind of sitcom with no text and all improvise. A comedy centered on trio of roommates in a cohabitation in a Sherbrooke loft.
title: Rue King

overview: This intriguing tale of magic and witchcraft in which each episode follows the adventures of four youngsters - two being the offspring of the local minister - as they try to piece together clues from an ancient diary belonging to an old vicar which are coinciding with strange events going on in their village.
title: The Witches and the Grinnygog

overview: The Barbara Vine Mysteries is a British television mystery drama series, principally written by Sandy Welch and Jacqueline Holborough and directly solely by Tim Fywell. Adapted from a series of novels written by Ruth Rendell under the pseudonym of Barbara Vine.
title: The Barbara Vine Mysteries

overview: Angela Harper decides to save her family from the poverty trap by embarking on a bigamous marriage with a rich man.
title: The Beggar Bride

overview: A medical research scientist based at Cambridge University, and widowed father-of-two, often finds himself investigating bizarre and unexplained deaths, with the help of his assistant, Dr. Melanie Kilpatrick.
title: Bliss

overview: The fascinating biography of British 'Blonde Bombshell', Diana Dors, who brought Marylin Monroe-esque charms to the UK along with public scandals and personal tragedies.
title: The Blonde Bombshell

overview: A man's mistress agrees to train his elderly mother to run a marathon.
title: Born to Run

overview: Psychological thriller serial. Detective Inspector John McKeown becomes involved in the life of one of the chief suspects in a murder case, a 17 year old called Dex, who is bringing up his siblings alone.
title: Butterfly Collectors

overview: The playwright John Ashenden is recruited as a spy during the First World War by the British secret service but becomes increasingly disenchanted with the tasks he is given to perform. The start of each episode shows progressively more of an aged Ashenden living in France in the mid-1960s, reacting adversely to a piece of music on the radio.
title: Ashenden

overview: Bajo El Mismo Cielo is the story of Carlos Martinez, an undocumented Mexican father who lives in Los Angeles, a hard worker and honest struggling to give a better life to his two sons Luis and Rodrigo, but their greatest fear is being deported and losing his family.
title: Bajo El Mismo Cielo

overview: Each episode follows a single case in a busy magistrates' court.
title: Accused

overview: Call Red follows the adventures of an Air Ambulance squad, captained by Phillip Tulloch. The series draws upon a documentary-style feel, including hand-held camera work for helicopter-based scenes, and detailed outlines of the procedures carried out by the medics themselves.
title: Call Red

overview: This action-packed series will witness 2 special task force teams who are on a job to identify and probe in to the heinous crimes that have crippled the state of Tamil Nadu.
title: Police Diary 2.0

overview: After serving a sentence of ten years in prison for a murder he did not commit, Arjun is finally free. Little does he know that he's caught in the middle of a flesh-trafficking racket that threatens to upend his entire existence.
title: Zero KMS

overview: The reality of Kadu, a football player who has lost his motivation, exposes the underworld of the ball, such as Russian match-buying mafia, manager corruption, self-boycotting of the athletes themselves, and religious and family alienation.
title: Chuteira Preta

overview: A young man is reunited with his father, who has been presumed dead for ten years, and then tries to unravel the truth behind his disappearance.
title: Centrepoint

overview: When two MI6 officers are shot dead in an unmarked car, assassination attempts, money laundering operations and peace talks follow as hitman Martin Deeley is simultaneously chased by members of the IRA, the RUC and the army.
title: Children of the North

overview: With unique access to Australia's emergency services, first responders and local communities, and packed with information for communities on how to manage extreme weather events, Big Weather (And How to Survive It) is an emotionally gripping series filmed over one intense summer, and preparing us for more. Shot on the frontlines during Australia's Black Summer of 2019-20, this 3-part ABC factual series delivers an urgent and empowering message of how our weather is changing and what we can do to survive it. Big Weather presenter, Craig Reucassel charts the 2019-20 summer as oppressive heatwaves set temperature records that lead to Australia's worst fire season on record. Over this period more than 20 million hectares of forest went up in flames: a fifth of the continent's forest and an area twice the size of Belgium. Then in a cruel contradiction, catastrophic fire is followed by severe storms and flash floods.
title: Big Weather (And How to Survive It)

overview: Do you dare to talk to your partner about everything? Brave couples ask each other unfamiliar questions.
title: Gift

overview: Obsessive business tycoon Carl May effectively Clones his wife Joanna, then repudiates her when she is unfaithful – with the aim, as she discovers ten years after the separation, of taking one of the three young clones as his new wife when they have grown up.
title: The Cloning of Joanna May

overview: 1961. Cameraman Viktor Khrustalev and director Egor Myachin are trying to shoot a movie based on the script of their friend, who tragically died.
title: Оттепель

overview: Crime Story is a British true crime drama anthology television series. Each episode depicts the events leading up to and encompassing a notable true crime, including cases such as the Erwin Van Haarlem mystery and the Teacup Poisoner murders.
title: Crime Story

overview: Throughout the bulk of 20th century, in most parts of England and Wales, prosecution of criminal cases was handled by the police or, in some cases, an entity directly attached to the Home Office. Crown Prosecutor was thus the first serious examination of what it was like to work in the Crown Prosecution Service, a completely police-independent body, which itself had only been established in 1985.
title: Crown Prosecutor

overview: Angela Black's life appears idyllic: a lovely house in suburban London, days working as a volunteer at the dogs' home, two wonderful sons and a charismatic, hard-working husband, Olivier. However, beneath this façade of charmed domesticity, Angela is also the victim of domestic abuse. Trapped in a relationship she cannot escape, Angela is approached out of the blue by Ed, a private investigator, who spills Olivier's darkest secrets. When faced with some horrifying truths about her husband, a stunned Angela is left reeling. Can she really trust Ed? Can she leave behind her life as she knows it and finally free herself from Olivier? With one encounter, Angela's life switches from school runs and the dogs' home to private detectives and buried secrets as she risks everything she holds dear to fight back against the man who has suppressed and tormented her for most of her life.
title: Angela Black

overview: Our country has 57,000 truck drivers, of which only 750 are women. Lady Truckers follows female truck drivers on their daily heavy truck journeys.
title: Lady Truckers

overview: Solo performances of stand-up comedians from the underground and popular TV and Internet projects. Each new release is a new concert with its own atmosphere and humor.
title: Stand Up Аутсайд

overview: Viewer-generated clips from around the globe reveal some of the most unnerving paranormal incidents ever to be captured on camera. A panel of experts analyze the shocking footage as they attempt to explain the impossible.
title: Paranormal Captured

overview: Daylight Robbery focuses on four Essex housewives struggling with personal and domestic problems begin to consider the possibility of armed robbery as a way out of their various dilemmas.
title: Daylight Robbery

overview: Following the adventures of Penny, a girl who has a big talent and a big passion: singing. She decides to enroll in the most famous performing arts school, M.A.R.S. Her passion will encourage her to fight for her dreams alongside her best friend Camilla. And soon, the arrival of a boy will complicate things.
title: Penny on M.A.R.S.

overview: Diana: Her True Story is a telling of the story of Diana, Princess of Wales, based on the publication of the same name by Andrew Morton.
title: Diana: Her True Story

overview: In thriller serial Die Kinder, Sidonie Reiger gets mixed up with the sinister German Red Liberation Front movement after her children are kidnapped.
title: Die Kinder

overview: When 40-something divorcee Jess's son is killed in a drink-drive road crash, she finds comfort with the driver of the car.
title: Every Woman Knows a Secret

overview: Chef Gary Mehigan visits India to explore the bubbling food scene in Delhi and Mumbai. From visiting premium restaurants and the coolest joints to meeting India's leading chefs and restaurateurs, while hanging out with celebrities, it's a culinary roller coaster ride.
title: Masters of Taste with Gary Mehigan

overview: Will the actions of those at the fringes have a disproportionate – and irreversible – impact on the United States?
title: Fringe Nation

overview: Style, home decor, and cooking how-to series hosted by lifestyle maven B. Smith.
title: B. Smith with Style

overview: A high-ranking government official's career is placed in jeopardy when his daughter reveals his extramarital affair to her boyfriend, a reporter.
title: Faith

overview: Period drama serial Falling for a Dancer was set in 1930's rural Ireland where young Elizabeth Sullivan falls pregnant after a brief affair. Her parents force her into marriage with a widower farmer.
title: Falling for a Dancer

overview: Ten aspiring creature creators competing to out-imagine one another in a series of challenges where they build everything from mechanical characters to whimsical beasts, bringing high-end creature designs to life. The contestants compete for a prize worth up to $100,000 including the opportunity for the job of a lifetime - a contract working at the world-renowned Jim Henson's Creature Shop™.
title: Jim Henson's Creature Shop Challenge

overview: Four couples travel to sunny Italy in search of one answer: am I here with the right one or is there someone who is better for me? Separately, they embark on an adventure in two villas. No seducers this time, but bachelors who are looking for a serious relationship.
title: Temptation Island: Love or Leave

overview: Family centres on the Spencers, a working-class family living in a vast Dublin housing estate. Charlo, is the abusive and cheating husband of Paula, They have four children, teenagers John Paul and Nicola, and younger children Leanne and Jack. There were four episodes, each focusing on a member of the family.
title: Family

overview: Bathsheba Everdene, a beautiful and proud woman with a fiercely independent spirit, in this powerful and lush adaptation of Thomas Hardy's classic story of passion and destruction set in the nineteenth century.
title: Far from the Madding Crowd

overview: Finney, a television spin-off from the 1988 film Stormy Monday is a six-part British television crime drama series and follows the struggle for power between two rival crime families - the Finneys and the Simpsons.
title: Finney

overview: Suspicion is a contagion. What starts as a tiny spark of doubt focused on one individual can metastasize and cast a shadow on everything you, your community, and ultimately law enforcement thought to be true. Each episode of Suspicious Minds creates a visceral viewing experience where a murder mystery unfolds as a psychological thriller where suspicion and doubt cloud the perceptions of everyone involved.
title: Suspicious Minds

overview: In a world surrounded by an invisible sphere of infinite data, explore the mysterious glitches that can occur and the strange phenomenon of unknown signals.
title: Phantom Signals

overview: The iconic interior design series is back. Presented by Anna Richardson, with designer Laurence Llewelyn-Bowen and design duo Russell Whitehead & Jordan Cluroe.
title: Changing Rooms with Dulux

overview: "Voice" is a Russian reality talent show, which premiered on October 5, 2012 on the First Channel of Russian Television. The Golos is part of The Voice's international syndication based on a reality singing competition launched in the Netherlands called The Voice of Holland.
title: Голос

overview: Emmy awarding winning host RuPaul drives and interviews a slew of celebrities through LA.
title: RuPaul Drives...

overview: Growing up fascinated by telenovelas, Valentina has always been a little bit extra when it comes to living La Vida. Winner of Miss Congeniality from RuPaul's Drag Race season 9, Valentina's lovable personality shines through as she shares intimate details about her life such as her first kiss and her fear of driving, all told in the style of a telenovela.
title: La Vida De Valentina

overview: World famous drag queen Bianca del Rio learns the hard way that Hollywood is nothing like the movie "Pretty Woman."
title: Not Today Bianca

overview: The Vivienne - er, President Trump - addresses the nation during these trying times.
title: Trump Learns Things

overview: After realizing she isn't the iconic dancer she thought, Scarlet takes dance classes from the best! Join her on her journey with teachers like Mark Kanemura, Connie Wood, and many more!
title: Envy of My Boogie

overview: Monét spills the real tea about the story behind the history we all think we know. From American history, pirate myths, to nursery rhymes, Monét is here to remind us that reading about history is what? Fundamental.
title: Monét's Herstory X Change

overview: From 20th Digital Studio, Bite Size Halloween is a series of stand-alone horror shorts ranging from the terrifying to the ridiculous. These short films explore different areas of the horror genre and provide a platform for exciting up-and-coming filmmakers.
title: Bite Size Halloween

overview: The story of a heroic man, a childhood dream carried over from the past to the present, of difficult lives in difficult geographies, of those who destroyed themselves and their surroundings while protecting their roots. The love for children, a story of impossible loves, of those who were saved from the brink of death; the story of "Ada Masalı" and of being honourable...
title: Şeref Sözü

overview: Gönül Dağı tells the story of the friendly, affectionate Anatolian people living in a charming town in the middle Bozkır.
title: Gönül Dağı

overview: The Chicago Code follows the Windy City's most powerful and respected cops as they navigate the city's underbelly to fight crime and expose corruption.
title: The Chicago Code

overview: Class is in session with Martin Hall, an award-winning golf teacher and the winner of Golf Channel's nationwide search in 2010 for the network's next instructor on School of Golf. Each week his unique teaching style is on display with tips and drills utilizing an in-studio golf simulator. He also answers plenty of viewer emails and incorporates other forms of social media to help drive the show's content.
title: School of Golf

overview: Pank is based on a true story from the turbulent Estonian 90s. Personal dramas will unfold using the historic events as a backdrop, with the characters constantly re-evaluating the currency rates and their personal values.
title: Pank

overview: Frank Skinner and Denise Mina travel through Scotland on boats and horses in a bid to recreate James Boswell's and Dr Johnson's trip to the Hebrides.
title: Boswell & Johnson's Scottish Road Trip

overview: A middle-class white housewife and her Indian cleaning lady set up a catering business together.
title: Firm Friends

overview: Four comedians from Brazil riff on sexuality, politics, religion and motherhood -- and set out to prove a woman's place is anywhere she wants it to be.
title: Lugar de Mulher

overview: Edgar Pascoe is a cardiac surgeon of high repute but sclerotic emotions. He is here to represent the cold detachment of modern technological medicine, a theme underlined by his participation in a scheme to market virtual-reality diagnosis to third- world countries (you don't even have to be in the same country as the patient, you see). Opposed to him is his wife, Lileth, a believer in the curative powers of empathy and communication.
title: The Fragile Heart

overview: Frankie's House is a 1992 British-Australian TV miniseries based on the biography of British photographer Tim Page, especially focusing on his relationship with Sean Flynn - the son of Errol Flynn - during the Vietnam War.
title: Frankie's House

overview: Frontiers focuses on the rivalry between two rival police chiefs of the Special Crime Squad and their respective teams of officers.
title: Frontiers

overview: The Australian version of the popular British TV interior design show.
title: Changing Rooms

overview: British anthology series of ghost stories set in modern Britain.
title: Ghosts

overview: Delicious food from Tokyo's markets! Learn about the amazing ingredients which are sourced from across Japan and sold at Tokyo's fresh food markets.
title: Trails to Oishii Tokyo

overview: The protagonist of the story, Ercüment Çözer rebels against disrespect and rudeness that we tend to avoid, ignore and eventually forget. Ercüment is a sociopath obsessed with the idea of respect. However, this time, he is not alone on his obsessive journey. The young lovers Helen and Savaş, who have just stepped foot into the real world, find themselves in the middle of difficult situations after being mistreated by a group of people and end up being responsible for a chain of murders that take place in Istanbul. The concept of disrespect instantly turns into a social and mediatic struggle between the two generations. As for the mediatic follow up, Turkey's most famous morning show host, Hasret will undertake it, however, nobody knows that she is also about to take part in this journey on another level. By getting to the core of this obsession, we will be witnessing the reflection it has on society.
title: Saygı

overview: As Yevgeni Grushko, head of the Criminal Investigation Division of the St Petersburg police, continues his inquiry into two brutal murders in the city, he begins to uncover the most horrific story of his career. A murdered TV journalist was working on a television documentary - an exploration into nuclear waste and possible mass radiation. But there is a missing link - Grushko and his sidekicks, Nikolai and Sasha, search relentlessly for the key.
title: Grushko

overview: Sam, a middle-aged executive in the roller-coaster industry embarks on an affair with Allie, a younger woman, jeopardizing his marriage.
title: Have Your Cake and Eat It

overview: The Long Haul is set against the backdrop of the hyper-masculine world of long haul trucking. A young mother and her teenage daughter flee their small-town. The series charts the journey of these two disenfranchised women navigating life on the road and their dysfunctional relationship, as they slowly, mile by mile, take their power back.
title: The Long Haul

overview: Exploits of a group of girls at a 1950s finishing school.
title: Head Over Heels

overview: The series is about a young teacher at a tough Liverpool high school. After working in a factory, Drew Mackenzie manages to educate himself to become a teacher. He wants to share his idealistic approach to rising above his circumstances with his Liverpool students, but soon finds himself caught in the crossfire of racial tensions, homophobia, and the difficult home lives of the teenagers.
title: Hearts and Minds

overview: A stunning tv travel series aimed at protecting and promoting Romania's natural and cultural legacy. Join us for a road trip through Romania's great historic regions celebrating the country's diverse cultures, landscapes, gastronomy, people and music and showing how eco-tourism and conservation could provide the best road map for the future.
title: Flavours of Romania

overview: Based on true events, the series presents 6 separate stories each one in 10 episodes, that voice women's concerns in modern society.
title: Ela Ana

overview: Get ready for sketch comedy...Canadian style! The Kids In The Hall are a hilarious sketch comedy troupe. They got their name from a comedian named Jack Benny, who would often end a joke by saying: "I got this from the kids in the hall", referring to the amateur comedians who would hang around outside his office. KITH was formed in 1984 when McCulloch and McKinney, who had worked together in Calgary as part of a group named the Audience, teamed up with Foley and McDonald's Toronto-based group, KITH. Thompson officially joined in January 1985. That same year, McCulloch and McKinney were hired as writers for NBC's Saturday Night Live after a talent scout saw KITH in performance. Significantly, SNL had also been created by Michaels, himself an ex-patriate Canadian living and producing in New York. Still in 1985, Foley appeared in the film High Stakes, and Thompson and McDonald toured with...
title: The Kids in the Hall

overview: Things go awry when British and Australian commandos try to bomb Singapore harbor during World War II. Heroes II: The Return is a British/Australian mini-series about Operation Rimau during World War II.
title: Heroes II: The Return

overview: History's Greatest Mysteries will investigate a wide range of historically compelling topics and the mysteries surrounding each including the Titanic, D.B. Cooper, Roswell, John Wilkes Booth, and more. Each program within the franchise will showcase fresh, new evidence and perspectives including never-before-released documents to the general public, personal diaries and DNA evidence to unearth brand-new information about these infamous and enigmatic chapters in history.
title: History's Greatest Mysteries

overview: On March 3, 2010, single mother Barbara Hamburg was found violently murdered near her home in the upper middle class enclave of Madison, Connecticut. Investigators speculated her murder appeared to be a crime of passion, but without enough evidence, the case grew cold. Over the course of 8 years, Barbara's son, Madison Hamburg, interviewed his family members and many others, longing to learn more about his mother and gathering evidence in hopes of solving her murder, sending him into a deep web of buried familial secrets, connections to shadowy criminal figures, and the uncovering of years-old resentments in his deceptively serene hometown. While Madison wrestles with troubling revelations about his mother, the most unsettling conflict comes from Madison's obligation to bring into question those inside his community and members of his own family.
title: Murder on Middle Beach

overview: Four years after Donald Trump unexpectedly became president of the most powerful nation on earth, The Trump Show tells the inside story of this most extraordinary presidency, with contributions from key players including Steve Bannon, Sean Spicer, Omarosa Manigault Newman and Anthony Scaramucci.
title: The Trump Show
